suggestion.title: New jutsu icon
suggestion.rationale: New icon from the director-approved starter jutsu icon set.

New icon: a cloud of venom miasma forming a looming, fanged face, matching a fear-inducing poison technique that makes the target take more damage. It replaces the old small scene of a posing ninja, which was hard to read at small sizes.
